actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMelfsAcidA]{Melf's Acid Arrow} (level 4 version).

actions.name: acid breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=qNI6W02jCUQbPpYE]]-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]], +13 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFear000000]{Fear}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMelfsAcidA]{Melf's Acid Arrow} (level 4 version) 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCreateUnde]{Create Undead}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithD]{Speak with Dead}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplVitriolicS]{Vitriolic Sphere} (level 5 version)

actions.name: cloud of insects
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=0OkFhjOM80ipoNKy]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=0OkFhjOM80ipoNKy]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has Disadvantage on saving throws to maintain &Reference[Concentration} until the end of its next turn. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: frightful presence
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFear000000]{Fear}. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
